assets.title: Original Mobile Canister Workshop Dust Collector
assets.description: Original static mobile single-stage workshop dust collector: hollow pleated upper canister, open collector plenum, separate opaque lower collection bag, side blower and motor, bare open inlet, retaining clamps, rear push handle, steel supports and four bored caster wheels. Limited teal, satin steel, charcoal and warm pale PBR palette. No connected hose, validated mating fit, motion, collection or filtration performance, health protection, explosion protection, load rating, operation, manufacture or safety certification is claimed.
